blurb: Phoenix East Aviation has trained pilots from almost every country globally for over 50 years. They offer multiple programs including standard, accelerated, and educational routes to obtain pilot licenses and become professional pilots. The school has 3 locations in Florida, over 65 modern aircraft, national accreditation, and partnerships with airlines.
